brief.job: Choose the incident that needs intervention now and take the next safe response.
brief.consequence: A wrong priority delays revenue-impacting recovery while an actual breach grows.
facts: The dashboard refreshes every 60 seconds. Data older than 120 seconds is stale.
Payments API has been above its 750 ms p95 SLO for 143 minutes: p95 2.8 s, error rate 8.4% versus a 1.0% SLO, and 842 failed checkouts in the last hour.
Search has p95 1.2 s against a 1.5 s SLO, error rate 0.9% against a 0.5% SLO, and has been elevated for 18 minutes.
Image processing has p95 4.1 s against a 5.0 s SLO, error rate 0.2% against a 0.5% SLO, and has no active customer impact report.
Checkout workers are at 94% utilization and have 12 minutes of queue capacity remaining. Search workers are at 63% utilization.
The last deploy was payments-api 2026.07.28.3, 151 minutes ago. The first payment errors appeared 148 minutes ago.
Permitted actions are acknowledge incident, open runbook, page checkout owner, rollback payments-api, and adjust worker capacity. Rollback requires a confirmation step.

required_interactions: Initiate but do not silently execute rollback
required_states: partial data failure for one noncritical region
acceptance_checks: A reviewer can identify the first incident to act on within five seconds.
Every decision-driving value includes an explicit comparison, target, or time context.
No customer, metric, incident, or capability beyond this brief is asserted.
